changelog: NEW: BLIND TOUCH - a separate mode next to BLIND: after you enter the opponent's move, it plays Stockfish's move for you with two taps
BLIND TOUCH works only in Chess for Android (com.google.android.chess), only in a local game against the computer; it checks the app and the board before every tap and stops on any doubt
Settings: BLIND TOUCH delay before the first tap - 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5 or 3 seconds
BLIND TOUCH needs Accessibility: Settings > Accessibility > CHESS4U BLIND TOUCH (Android only)
